accepted_invariants: The C callback pump installs its guard only after ada_lua_dispatch returns; actual K callbacks are invoked by the C pump with saved status/context and do not nonlocally jump across active Ada scheduler frames.

Each pending C call now records its owning activation. Suspension selects the foreign boundary belonging to that activation rather than repeatedly marking the nearest sentinel; three nested K boundaries are covered by named case20 and the unchanged coroutine tail.
Resume preserves its live scalar execution window and places host-facing results outside suspended registers; a later resume roots supplied arguments before restoring the saved execution view.

Completed child resume driver/call/context/native-depth ownership is restored before fallible host-result publication, so a refused result-window growth cannot strand the parent under the completed driver.

A successfully completed thread with an actual new callable can be reused through public C resume; missing-body/error-dead/running states remain distinguished. Independent from-state identity supplies depth without replacing the resumed universe.

Synchronous success returns to the original C body even when yieldable. A protected error in a yieldable K-aware frame reaches K even before a yield; resumed error versus YIELD status and full-width context are real frame data.

C hook line/count yields preserve the interrupted instruction and live registers. Public valid getstack/getinfo line inspection skips the synthetic transport callback; suspended debug locals use the retained hook PC.
The public C debug selector scope is explicitly l only. Expired-frame rejection is an Ada safety invariant and is not claimed as valid native C behavior.
Retiring C activations run their actual to-be-closed slots on return/error/resumed continuation, with retained outgoing result/error roots through collection.
Protectedness survives suspension on the actual foreign boundary: a later unprotected callk error sets the caller failure stage and does not invoke K; only pcallk may resume K with an error status.

Discard_Pending restores owned/borrowed driver identity, saved call stack, current context and native depth on exceptional resume exits before freeing scalar metadata. Boundary result packets are reserved before driver ownership changes; completed results move without a new uncontrolled packet allocation. Create_Surface rolls back both blocks and publishes only after initialization.

A root public call above suspended frames records its retained entry depth. Completion, temporary frame cleanup and failure cancellation stop at that depth, preserve the suspended lifecycle status and restore the original public prefix before publishing results.

C settop/closeslot schedule a private owner-bound close helper only after the Ada dispatcher returns. The ordinary iterative unwind driver closes and retires crossed slots, permitting depth reuse; explicit closeslot detaches the old cell and writes nil before its C body continues.

Yield permission and hook result/K constraints are validated before publishing any transfer or continuation fields. Public yield refusal chooses the pinned main-thread versus C-boundary wording. Invalid/dead/non-suspended resume errors pop supplied arguments; setup allocation refusal consistently leaves the failed target error-dead while restoring the healthy caller.

Lua-side suspension records a detached empty public window and the previous execution view. Both Lua/C takeover restore that view before actual argument delivery. An interrupted Lua instruction discards hook resume arguments instead of retaining them in an unrelated native-result packet.

Stacks.Trace marks the saved true host prefix and merges the detached public interval in order with real activation windows; neither dead register gaps nor a high public result address become implicit roots.

A pending count-hook yield is published only after the due line event for that same instruction, before execution. Error retirement clears the pending request. The suspended PC remains the actual interrupted instruction.

Short_Source matches pinned lobject.c chunk identifiers: at most59 bytes, literal truncation, file-tail truncation, first-line snippet truncation at45 bytes and the same bracketed identifier in debug metadata and error prefixes.

Public library opening/cache selection follows the pinned stack algorithms. Direct debug/string/table/utf8 witnesses require real export calls and no implicit module-global publication; requiref preserves truthy module identity and reopens a false entry. The reviewed constructor regions exclude my authored Math_Module generator change.
